title: Admissions
intro: Five clear steps, one conversation, and a transparent fee structure. We read every application ourselves — across Baby Class, Nursery (KG1 & KG2), NECTA Grades 1–6, and Cambridge Years 1–6.
openNote: Admissions for the January 2027 intake (2026/2027 academic year) are open now across Pre-Primary, NECTA Primary, and our Cambridge International Wing. Apply early to secure your child's desk.

steps.title: Enquire or visit
steps.text: Call, WhatsApp +255 777 427 140, or fill the enquiry form. Ask for a Saturday Open Day tour at 10:00 or any weekday morning by appointment.

steps.title: Submit the application
steps.text: Apply online in about six minutes, or collect the paper form from the front office in Kisakasaka.

steps.title: Assessment & family meeting
steps.text: Play-based observation for Baby Class & Nursery, or a friendly placement check in English and numeracy for Grades 1–6 / Years 1–6, plus a conversation with parents.

steps.title: Offer & registration
steps.text: Written offers are sent within five working days with the official 2026/2027 fee schedule. New students pay the one-time TZS 100,000 registration fee and first instalment to confirm their place.

steps.title: Orientation & first day
steps.text: Uniform fitting, stationery pack allocation, school bus route assignment, and new-family orientation before classes begin in January 2027.

requirements.title: What you need to provide
requirements.note: Clear copies are fine when you apply; original documents are checked at the admissions desk before your child's first day.

groups.title: Every applicant
items: Birth certificate or passport extract (for non-Tanzanian applicants).
Latest school report or transfer letter (for pupils transferring into Grade 1–6 / Year 1–6).
Immunisation card and any medical or allergy notes.
Parent or guardian ID and contact details.

groups.title: Baby Class & Nursery (KG1 & KG2)
items: Baby Class: from age 2.5–3 years; Nursery (KG1 & KG2): ages 3.5–5 years.
No written entrance test — only a warm, play-based observation session with our early-years teachers.
Includes breakfast, hot lunch, stationery, and daily care.

groups.title: NECTA Primary Wing (Grade 1 – 6)
items: Placement in Grade 1–3 or Grade 4–6 according to age and completed class.
Short diagnostic check in English, Kiswahili, and Mathematics.
Transfer students with clear progress reports are placed directly.

groups.title: Cambridge International Wing (Year 1 – 6)
items: Placement in Lower Primary (Year 1–3) or Upper Primary (Year 4–6).
Age-appropriate placement check in English literacy, numeracy, and inquiry readiness.
Ideal for families seeking the Cambridge Assessment International Education curriculum in Zanzibar.

fees.title: Official 2026/2027 Fee Structure
fees.note: Fees for the NECTA (Tanzanian national) and Cambridge (international) curricula are set per annum in Tanzanian Shillings (TZS) and may be paid in twelve (12) equal monthly instalments.

registrationFee.label: Registration Fee — New Students Only
registrationFee.text: A one-time registration fee of TZS 100,000 is payable by all new students on admission, in addition to the annual fees below.

covers: All timetabled tuition (NECTA or Cambridge Wing)
Daily school breakfast & hot nutritious lunch
Caution fee (included in the monthly schedule)
Science laboratory, ICT lab & library borrowing
excluded: One-time registration fee of TZS 100,000 (new students only)
School uniform and sports kit (communicated separately)
School bus transport (per-route fare where applicable)
fees.footnote: All fees are quoted in Tanzanian Shillings (TZS) and apply per student. Monthly instalments are the annual fee divided into twelve equal parts, rounded to the nearest shilling; the annual fee is the binding amount. School uniform and club fees are not yet included in this fee structure and will be communicated separately.

bursaries.title: Sibling support & bursary enquiries
bursaries.text: We aim to keep world-class NECTA and Cambridge education accessible to hardworking Zanzibari families. Speak with our bursary desk regarding sibling arrangements or scholarship consideration.

bands.for: Available to every enrolled family across NECTA and Cambridge wings
Outstanding performance in primary placement or continuing assessments
Verified household need reviewed confidentially by the school board

bursaries.how: Download the official 2026/2027 Fee Structure PDF or visit the administration office on Kisakasaka Road to discuss payment plans.
